scope: Candidate 1.2.0 evaluates supported mixed intersect/except pattern chains from left to right in the effective XSLT 4.0 profile. Both operators have equal precedence: `root except missing intersect missing` does not match root, while `root except (missing intersect missing)` does. The matcher preserves parenthesized grouping, union precedence, quoted/URI operator text and existing all-path/all-axis expression evaluation. Missing operands in mixed chains raise XTSE0340. Earlier profiles retain their existing dispatch behavior. Eighteen new regressions cover membership, nonmatches, grouping, union precedence, URI/quoted punctuation, path/axis negatives and earlier-profile behavior. The baseline was 10/8/0 before the fix; focused new plus prior operator checks pass 41/0/0. Native next-match remains 46/8/6 and type-alias remains 22/10/0; prior gains remain green and upstream assertions/fixtures are unchanged. Forward-axis operand focus in 4.0 set patterns, broader grammar/set semantics, lower-version native fixture processor selection, schema-defined atomic priorities, fixed namespace/authoring contexts, non-template type registries, remaining record/result cases and annotated function types remain follow-ups. N04/N05 and REQ-126 remain In Progress. Published version remains 1.1.3; candidate 1.2.0 remains unpublished.
validation: Final incremental Release build succeeds with zero warnings and zero errors. All 7600 unit tests across ten assemblies pass with zero failures/skips, including XSLT 4714/0/0 and eighteen new regressions; focused associativity/operator regressions pass 41/0/0. Frozen QT3 exactly 31142/0/679; qt4 gate-only 8278/0/1894 with zero gated failures. Native next-match, including si-next-match, remains 46/8/6; type-alias remains 22/10/0 with all prior wildcard/type-pattern gains retained. Both native filtered runners exit 1 for their remaining failures; no assertions or fixture versions changed. Fifteen synchronized documentation pages render successfully.
